September 4, 1916

Contempt of Mayor and Council

That if any person Shall offer contempt, or use any immoral or obscene language or make any threats or do anything to disturb the Mayor and Council while in session, he shali be fined not less than one Dollar and cost or more than Ten Dollers and cost, or work on the streets for any time not exceeding ten days within the discretion of the Mayor and Council, the Mayor heing endowed with power to assess the fines against such offenders.

That if the Mayor or any member of the Council shall order any person in the Corporate limits of the Town of Chipley, Georgia to desist fron doing anything that will injure any public building, Church, school house, college or any street, sidewalk or any bridge or street crossing, or any private property belonging to any one,other than the offender, and said person shall refuse to obey said order, said person offending shell be held in contempt, and Fined not less then one, nor More than twenty-five dollars and cost, or work on streets of the Town not exceeding thirty days.
